title: Skincare After Sun Exposure in India: What to Do and What to Pause
ex: What to do the same evening after too much sun, what to pause for a few days, how to deal with a tan later, and when to see a doctor.
rt: Skincare After Sun Exposure in India: Simple Steps | Mirc Glow
rd: Skincare after sun exposure in India: how to cool and soothe skin, which actives to pause, tan vs sunburn, gentle next steps and when to see a doctor.
quick: After too much sun, rinse with cool water, use a mild cleanser, apply aloe vera or a simple soothing cream, moisturise and drink water. Pause scrubs, retinol, acids and brightening actives until skin calms. Then use daily sunscreen; a tan fades as skin renews over about 4–6 weeks.
facts: Darker skin tones can get sunburnt too.
Pause scrubs and strong actives on sun-stressed skin.
Mirc Glow creams do not contain SPF and do not replace sunscreen.
